item.title: MCP vs REST API for Localization: When to Use Each
item.description: Lokalise gives developers two programmatic ways to manage localization workflows: the REST API and the MCP Server. In any MCP vs API localization decision, the key point is that one does not replace the other. The REST API is built for scripted, repeatable, deterministic automation, such as CI/CD pipelines, batch imports, and webhook-driven deployments.
